label: sdc01_0340_select_02
text: The Pokémon from the old folktale!

label: sdc01_0340_sister_06
text: Hey, you’re right! There were three of ’em, and\nthey looked all sinister! That’s gotta be them![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0340_sister_07
text: The story said they were laid to rest under the\nstatues, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0340_sister_08
text: What brought them back to life?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0340_sister_09
text: Wait, they ran off toward Kitakami Hall![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0340_sister_10
text: That can’t be good! Let’s go after ’em! Come\non, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0340_gfather_01
text: Kieran came back not too long ago, but...I think\nyou should leave him be for now.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0340_people_01
text: The Loyal Three have come back to life! How\nauspicious!

label: sdc01_0340_people_02
text: Did you see them?! The Loyal Three came here\nto Kitakami Hall!

label: sdc01_0340_people_03
text: The Loyal Three look kinda sinister, don’t they?\nThey must be what’s called antiheroes!

label: sdc01_0340_people_04
text: Ooh ooh! I locked eyes with the real Munkidori!
